method: Point-in-time host /proc inventory. Reads browser command lines only for status names chrome/chromium, selects any argument beginning --headless, emits PID/group/session/start ticks/RSS and booleans for this workspace and Playwright profile only. No command lines, URLs or profile paths emitted. Process races and read failures are counted; an empty match list does not certify all host processes, detached descendants, browser names outside the two-name filter, current/peak RSS, CPU or causation. No signal or process mutation.
